_comment: isiZulu API draft generated through the Anthropic API (2026-10-24) from ui.en.json, with the D4 strings as glossary. Native-speaker review required; the language stays labelled beta.
english_only_note: Ezinye izikrini zisesesiNgisini ngenkathi ukuhumusha kusahlolwa.
auth_demo_note: Idatha ye-demo eyenziwe — akuyena umuntu wangempela.
auth_check_email: Hlola i-imeyili yakho ukuze uqinisekise i-akhawunti, bese ungena.
auth_error: Asikwazanga ukukungenisa. Hlola i-imeyili nephasiwedi yakho.
consent_body: I-Zaka isebenzisa imininingwane yemali oyifakayo ukukubonisa isilinganiso semali engenayo nephumayo nokuchaza izingozi ezingaba khona. Ungalungisa noma usule okufakile. Uma ucela i-Zaka ukuthi ihlole umlayezo, umbhalo ungase usetshenzwe yinsiza yethu ye-AI; qala ususe ama-PIN, amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa nemininingwane ye-akhawunti. I-Zaka ayithumeli imali futhi ayinqumi ukuthi uyafaneleka yini ukuthola isikweletu. Qhubeka kuphela uma uvuma.
consent_points_2: Asisoze sakucela i-PIN, i-OTP noma iphasiwedi yebhange.
onb_money_hint: Imali esephaketheni kanye nesebhange. Inani elicishe libe yilo lilungile.
onb_income_hint: Khetha konke okusebenzayo. Sizofunda nakulokho okufakayo.
onb_costs_hint: Sigcwalisa kusengaphambili lokho esingakwazi. Shintsha noma iyiphi inombolo ibe ngeyakho.
mode_bus: Ibhasi (MyCiTi, Rea Vaya, A Re Yeng…)
type_it_failed: Asikwazanga ukukufunda. Sebenzisa izinombolo esikhundleni salokho.
queued: Kugcinwe kule foni — kuzovumelaniswa uma usuxhumekile.
shortfall_moved: Usuku lwakho lokushoda kwemali lususuke ku-{from} lwaya ku-{to}.
shortfall_cleared: Manje akubikezelwa ukuphela kwemali ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezizayo.
conf_why_low: Izinsuku ezingaphansi kuka-14 noma okufakile okungaphansi kuka-6 kuze kube manje.
conf_why_medium: Izinsuku ezingu-{days} zomlando, okufakile okuqinisekisiwe okungu-{count}.
conf_why_high: Izinsuku ezingu-{days} zomlando, okufakile okungu-{count}, nephethini ebonwe kangu-3 noma ngaphezulu.
safe_none: Ayikho imali ongayisebenzisa ngaphambi kuka-{date}. Izidingo ezibalulekile kuqala.
tight_body: Ngale ndlela imali yakho ingase iphele ngaphambi kokuthi kufike imali elandelayo. Faka imali oyilindele noma ushintshe inkokhelo ukuze kubuyekezwe.
ins_monthly_income: I-{source} yakho ecishe ibe ngu-{amount} ivame ukufika cishe mhla zingu-{day} — kubonwe kangu-{count}.
ins_recurring_weekly: I-{source} ecishe ibe ngu-{amount} ivame ukufika ngo-{weekday} — kubonwe kangu-{count}.
ins_piece_jobs: Uthola cishe amatogo angu-{perWeek} ngesonto, ngokuvamile cishe u-{amount}.
ins_tight_day: Imali ivame ukushoda kakhulu cishe mhla zingu-{day} enyangeni.
ins_busy_weekday: Ngo-{weekday} uvame ukusebenzisa imali eningi kakhulu (cishe u-{amount}).
ins_shortfall_gap: Cishe u-{amount} owengeziwe ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezizayo ungavala igebe eliqala ngo-{date}.
plan_horizon_income: Uhlelo luphela emalini yakho elandelayo okungenzeka ifike ({source}, {date}).
plan_horizon_cap: Ayikho imali okungenzeka ifike ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezizayo, ngakho sihlela zonke izinsuku ezingu-14.
plan_low_path_note: Isilinganiso esiqaphile: imali okungenzeka ifike ibalwa uhhafu, imali engaqinisekile ayibalwa. Yonke inombolo iyisilinganiso ongasishintsha.
goal_daily: Beka eceleni cishe u-{amount} ngosuku ukuze uwufinyelele ngo-{date}.
scam_intro: Namathisela i-SMS, i-WhatsApp noma i-imeyili. I-Zaka iqala iyihlole kule foni ukuthola izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezivamile.
scam_low_body: Lokho akusho ukuthi uphephile. Uma ucela imali noma imininingwane, qala uqinisekise ngokwakho.
scam_explain_failed: Asikwazanga ukuthola incazelo manje. Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezingenhla zisasebenza.
scam_not_stored: Umlayezo wakho awugcinwa. Sigcina kuphela izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezitholakele.
flag_impersonation: Uthi uvela ku-SASSA, ebhange noma enhlanganweni esemthethweni
flag_new_number: Indaba ethi "inombolo entsha" noma umndeni osenkingeni
flag_personal_info: Ucela imininingwane ye-ID, yekhadi noma ye-akhawunti
loan_intro: Faka imigomo ebhaliwe yobolekayo. I-Zaka iyihlanganisa ngamarandi.
loan_within_limit: Inzalo ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni walolu hlobo lwesikweletu.
loan_rights: Obolekayo akavunyelwe nanini ukugcina ikhadi lakho le-SASSA, ikhadi lebhange noma i-ID.
me_delete_confirm: Lokhu kusula i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okufakile. Akunakubuyiswa. Bhala u-DELETE ukuze uqinisekise.
me_reset_demo_note: Kubuyisa amasonto angu-10 enziwe kaLerato, aphele namuhla.
me_about_body: I-Zaka yakhiwe yi-JustIT Solutions. Zonke izibalo zenziwa yikhodi efonini yakho futhi ziboniswa kokuthi "Kungani lesi kuyisilinganiso?". I-AI isetshenziswa kuphela ukufunda umusho owubhalayo nokuchaza izimpawu eziyisixwayiso zobuqola.
me_offline_cache: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: uhlelo lwakho lokugcina nokusha okufakile kugcinwa kule foni.
error_generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Okufakile kuphephile kule foni.
logout_pending: Okufakile okungu-{count} kusalinde ukuvumelaniswa futhi kuzolahleka uma uphuma manje. Uphume noma kunjalo?
loan_type_credit_facility: Ikhadi lesikweletu, ikhadi lesitolo noma i-overdraft
loan_cap_year: Umkhawulo osemthethweni: {rate}% ngonyaka (izinga le-repo {repo}% kanye nomkhawulo obekwe ngumthetho).
loan_simple_interest_note: Lapha inzalo ibalwa kuyo yonke imali isikhathi sonke. Uma ubuyisa ngezitolimende, inani olinikiwe lingase libe ngaphansi.
loan_rate_needed: Faka izinga lenzalo elisekhotheshini ebhaliwe ukuze uliqhathanise nomkhawulo osemthethweni.
loan_init_above: Imali yokuqalisa ingaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max} kule malimboleko.
loan_init_within: Imali yokuqalisa ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max}.
loan_service_above: Imali yesevisi yanyanga zonke ingaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max}.
loan_service_within: Imali yesevisi yanyanga zonke ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max}.

help_own_number: Sebenzisa inombolo ozitholele yona — ungalokothi usebenzise esemlayezweni.
help_use_saps: Bika ubugebengu noma unikeze ulwazi (amahora angu-24)
help_use_obs: Uma ibhange lakho lingasixazululi isikhalazo sakho
help_other_banks: Amanye amabhange: sebenzisa inombolo esemuva ekhadini lakho noma ku-app esemthethweni.
